name: Moving Mountains
overview: The Scriptures teach that moving mountains symbolizes the power of unwavering faith in God. Jesus emphasizes that even faith as small as a mustard seed can command mountains to move, demonstrating that nothing is impossible to those who trust God without doubt. This divine empowerment calls believers to rely fully on the Lord rather than their own understanding, approaching Him with persistent prayer and confident expectation. The prophetic imagery of mountains becoming plains underscores God’s ability to remove obstacles and bring about His purposes through faithful obedience and grace.
